Definition: Javan, the name of a son of Joktan, and of the race (Ionians, i.e. Greeks) descended from him, with their territory; also of a place in Arabia
BiblicalUsage: Javan = "Ionia" or "Greece"; n pr m; 1) a son of Japheth and grandson of Noah; n pr loc; 2) Greece, Ionia, Ionians; 2a) location of descendants of Javan
